description.zh: 数据库名。传入多个数据库时，各个数据库名称间使用英文逗号（,）进行分隔。
description.en: The name of the database. Separate multiple database names with commas (,).

description.zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
The ID of the database instance.

description.zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页最大记录数，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 10.

description.zh: SQL哈希值。将SQL语句进行Hash之后得出的值，同一种SQL对应同一个QueryHash。
description.en: The hash value of the SQL statement. The hash values of SQL statements of the same type are the same.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

title.zh: 查询RDS SQL Server实例的锁阻塞列表

descriptions.zh:
* 本接口仅适用于RDS SQL Server版实例。
* 使用阿里云或DAS的SDK时，建议使用最新版本。
* 在使用SDK调用DAS服务时，需要将地域指定为cn-shanghai。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances.

- If you use an Alibaba Cloud SDK or Database Autonomy Service (DAS) SDK to call this operation, we recommend that you use the latest version of the SDK.

- If you use an SDK to call the API operations of DAS, you must set the region ID to cn-shanghai.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun das get-blocking-detail-list --instance-id rm-t4nfalp2ap4210000 --start-time 1679429913757 --end-time 1682490480548 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --query-hash DC08B955CAD25E7B --db-name-list testdb1,testdb2 --region cn-hangzhou
